data.description: You have the ability to assume the appearance of the previous humanoid form that you used your fleshdrink ability on successfully, but retain most of your own physical qualities.  You cannot change shape to a form more than one size category smaller or larger than your original form. This ability functions as an alter self spell, but you do not adjust your ability scores (although you gain any other abilities of the creature you mimic).
